workarounds.note: renderPageToCanvas paints with the direction the canvas inherits from the page (ctx.direction 'inherit'); the cjk kit's showBook sets dir="rtl" on each spread of a right-bound book, so the horizontal Latin colophon would be reordered and anchored from the right. The pen sets #pages canvas { direction: ltr }; the fix belongs in renderPageToCanvas (ctx.direction = 'ltr') or in the kit's showBook style.

what.en: 論語集註 (Collected Commentaries on the Analects), juan 1, the book 學而 from its opening to the end of its tenth section, in the copy made for the 四庫全書 (Siku quanshu, 1773–1782); Wikisource transcription, revision 523110. 巳 is read as 已 or 己 by its sentence, and six variant forms Noto Serif TC does not draw (廹 徳 絶 逺 専 内) are set in their standard forms
what.es: 論語集註 (Comentarios reunidos a las Analectas), juan 1, el libro 學而 desde el comienzo hasta el final de su décima sección, en la copia hecha para el 四庫全書 (Siku quanshu, 1773–1782); transcripción de Wikisource, revisión 523110. 巳 se lee como 已 o 己 según la frase, y seis variantes que Noto Serif TC no dibuja (廹 徳 絶 逺 専 内) se componen en su forma normal
